title: Add a cross-host native-id negative control for the mailbox read argument diagnostic
outcome: A caller's mistaken bare native session id cannot select a diagnostic pair belonging to a target on another host; the host filter has a discriminating regression control.
acceptance: A disposable authenticated satellite test gives the caller an existing pair with a central-host target and submits that target's native id as mailboxId; the error says none for this same-host lookup and excludes that pair id.
The control fails if the production same-host filter is removed, while existing own-host pair/none and privacy controls pass.
